residual_check.reading: Residuals of log(MTTR) should be centred on 0, roughly symmetric (skew near 0) and not grow with the prediction (correlation near 0). Departures mean the linear model misses non-linear effects.

details.reading: Purity = share of incidents whose cluster's most common category matches their own. High purity with tight top terms means the clusters rediscover real recurring problems.
